title: 重返越南
description:
This is a single player FPS game where you can experience the fun of first person shooting. In infantry mode, you can choose to have 7 assault rifles and machine guns, 2 handguns, and a grenade. A compact infantry map. In vehicle mode, you can freely switch between first person and third person, and drive tanks and infantry fighting vehicles including M1A2, M2A3, M1128, T90, 2S23, BMP-2. Tank and infantry fighting vehicle AI have high intelligence and will choose to fire at high threat targets. Even if you shoot at them from a distance, they can still find you and retaliate against you! In the vehicle battle, have a huge desert map to occupy multiple strongholds. In addition, the weapons in the game can be freely matched with accessories, and each main weapon can use 6 different scopes, as well as assemble or remove silencers and infrared. In addition, the appearance of the weapon's skin can be changed according to your preferences. You can customize your own gun skin by obtaining any PNG format image on your disk in the game! Finally, the game also provides level settings such as number of players, special effects, and time scores, which can be freely combined.

Drivable vehicles:

Customize the appearance of your weapon using photos stored on your computer (paste the disk path of your photo into the game and press enter to see your image! Supports PNG and JPG formats, unlimited resolution):
description_short: Back to Vietnam is a first-person shooting game. Have smart AI to play with you!
